g.text: GPT-4.1: direct OpenAI API • GPT-5.6: Amazon Bedrock Mantle • August 26–30, 2026

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #253242

g.text: Completion is not answer correctness. Banking77 supplies 64.22% of cases; inspect each workload for gaps. No pooled latency or quality score.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #253242

g.text: * Sol/high: four ExtractBench attempts lack usage. Hatching extends metered spend to its conservative upper estimate, not a confidence interval.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526170

g.text: Descriptive cross-platform results. Reasoning settings differ in run timing, some output ceilings and overlapping execution; see methodology.
